title: FeaturePlanCoverageValidator
responsibility: Check affected visual page coverage from committed relationships and plan hierarchy.

inputs.name: validate.plan
inputs.description: Candidate feature plan with change tree and page options.

inputs.name: validate.data
inputs.description: Committed revision-bound registry, relationships and unresolved graph references.

inputs.name: discover.input
inputs.description: Committed source revision and module change tree; page designs are not required.

inputs.name: discover.data
inputs.description: Matching committed registry, relationships and graph.

outputs.name: validate
outputs.description: Union direct changed pages, consuming pages from committed relationships and planned page ancestors; require a design entry for each. Requires source-bound available metadata and registered units. Reuse-only plans have no page impacts. For actual changes, block graph uncertainties reachable from active pages or unclassifiable; exclude only graph-proven unrelated references and include actionable diagnostics.

outputs.name: discover
outputs.description: Sorted unique affected pages and independent metadata, relationship, graph and hierarchy blockers. Partial impact is never valid when blockers exist.

errors.name: Incomplete coverage or graph
errors.description: Missing pages, unknown/inactive changed modules, absent relationship data or unresolved committed graph references reject without mutation.
